name: neuro-trading.
tagline: Simulates public sentiment with agent swarms and predicted brain responses to forecast opinion-driven markets.

awards: Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research

problem: Many prediction markets hinge on how public opinion cascades.
solution: Builds a simulation graph of agents that post, like and comment, informed by predicted brain responses to content, to forecast sentiment-driven market outcomes.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan bets, run the simulation, read the forecast.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research” among 212 submissions.
Models opinion contagion rather than polling.

lessons: Simulate the crowd when the outcome is a crowd's belief.
